query: How will we treat and adjudicate discrepancies between self-identified gender and coder-perceived gender in analysis specifications and sensitivity checks?

response.query: How will we treat and adjudicate discrepancies between self-identified gender and coder-perceived gender in analysis specifications and sensitivity checks?
response.answer: Discrepancies between self-identified and perceived gender will be resolved through sensitivity checks and consultation with relevant diversity and inclusion experts. Final decisions will respect individuals' self-identification. Ethical guidelines will be strictly followed.
